# The Organization Learning Labs (OLL)

> The Organization Learning Labs researches structural change in industries, business models, operating models and organizational capabilities. These insights inform future capability models and competence blueprints. The Enterprise Capability Readiness Assessment (ECRA) uses these models to explore how prepared organizations are to meet future capability requirements. OLL focuses on IT services and consulting, and retail banking.

Legal name: The Organization Learning Labs LLP. Based in India. Contact: support@ollacademy.com, +91 76766 46518.

## Enterprise Capability Readiness Assessment (ECRA)

- [ECRA overview](https://theorganizationlearninglabs.com/ecra): readiness at enterprise, business unit, function and role level, and how enterprise capability relates to individual competence.
- [Enterprise](https://theorganizationlearninglabs.com/ecra/enterprise): enterprise-wide capability readiness, strategic alignment and future operating requirements.
- [Business Unit / Organization](https://theorganizationlearninglabs.com/ecra/business-unit): readiness of a business unit or organizational entity to deliver future business outcomes.
- [Function / Capability Area](https://theorganizationlearninglabs.com/ecra/function-capability-area): readiness within a function, capability group or strategic transformation area, on a five-level maturity scale.
- [Leaders / Roles](https://theorganizationlearninglabs.com/ecra/leaders-roles): role-specific competence, workforce readiness and a Development Action Plan.
